articles.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
articles.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

articles.title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
articles.description: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.

articles.title: Deloitte helped in falsifying documents to evade tax on Abramovich’s wealth, BBC finds
articles.description: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

articles.title: Immigration agents search Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
articles.description: Omar was first elected to Congress in 2018, and is an outspoken critic of President Donald Trump.
